reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed target-cell somatic calcium-imaging calibration against paired electrophysiology, structural 3D motion reference, neuropil/expression sensitivity and visual-response validation.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) Used to Infer Neural Activity
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of prior paired-imaging/electrophysiology Methods, supplements or validated protocols to choose conditions and verify transfer.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) Used to Infer Neural Activity
checks.reason: The preparation lists co-expression and recovery, but no functional delivered indicator quantity or concrete calibration-to-choice procedure for constructing that preparation.

checks.quote: coefficients are estimated from these calibration frames
checks.reason: Jointly expressing channels under motion do not independently identify spectral unmixing coefficients. Single-label/reference measurements and a residual interference acceptance gate are missing.

checks.quote: fraction of supra-threshold fluorescence transients that lack a corresponding spike
checks.reason: This denominator defines false discovery proportion, not false-positive rate. Plotting sensitivity against it does not give the stated ROC; false events per valid time and unique event matching are also unresolved. Charge this metric defect once.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) Used to Infer Neural Activity
checks.reason: Cell-session pairs are treated as independent and the precision-based increase in cells lacks independent animal replication/nesting in the inferential sampling plan.

checks.quote: Only cells in the central tertile proceed
checks.reason: Selecting only the central expression tertile removes the low/high expression performance required for calibration; rejected performance regimes need retained coverage/failure accounting.

checks.quote: Correlation coefficient
checks.reason: No specified visual-response contrast test or multiplicity procedure; a spike-rate correlation and detection curve do not define the requested visual-response comparison.

checks.quote: reports z-displacement
checks.reason: Reference brightness drift is not uniquely axial displacement: bleaching and symmetric defocus can give the same intensity. A single intensity calibration is insufficient for signed 3D tracking; the expression ratio also is not independent of resting calcium/reference abundance.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) Used to Infer Neural Activity
checks.reason: Repairs are proposed but revised settings are not explicitly refrozen and evaluated on fresh independent confirmation data.

checks.quote: Select r that minimizes the residual
checks.reason: Neuropil coefficient, spike mapping and detection thresholds are fitted and assessed against the same paired data; no independent held-out animal/cell validation is operational.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) Used to Infer Neural Activity
checks.reason: No linked raw-data/cell/trial manifest with exact acquisition, processing and code/environment versions supports rerunning the result.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) Used to Infer Neural Activity
checks.reason: Prospective paired recordings, explicit biological/artifact comparisons, blinded analysts, bounded neuropil and threshold sweeps, saturation curves and ordered troubleshooting are useful. Incorrect error-rate terminology, non-identifying axial estimation, restricted expression sampling and same-data calibration/validation materially limit the scientific explanation; these are charged under specific checks.
